summary: iter215 — Two-track verification (Founding-50 broadcast template + Operator ops checklist). Frontend-only Playwright suite. 6/7 sub-flows PASS, 1 CRITICAL BUG in Settings → OperatorOpsChecklistCard: IndexNow ping is broken (ReferenceError: adminAuthHeaders is not defined). All other surfaces verified end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid=ops-indexnow-ping] fires a ReferenceError: 'adminAuthHeaders is not defined' (visible in toast + console). The button calls adminAuthHeaders() at line 668 but the helper is a module-private const inside /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js and is NOT imported into SettingsTab.jsx. As a result the POST to /api/admin/seo/ping is never sent and ops-indexnow-result never renders.

action_items: Fix Settings→OperatorOpsChecklistCard IndexNow ping: either (a) export adminAuthHeaders from /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js and import it in SettingsTab.jsx, or (b) replace the raw fetch with the existing axios `http` client + a wrapper like pingIndexNow() that already attaches the admin Bearer header (this is what every other admin call in api.js does). Repro: open /admin/dashboard?tab=settings, scroll to 'Operator ops checklist', click 'Ping IndexNow' → toast shows 'adminAuthHeaders is not defined'.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsTab.jsx uses adminAuthHeaders() without importing it — this is the only bug. The same file already calls fetchFeaturedSeedStatus / purgeFeaturedSeed / attributeWorkshopTeam through the centralized api.js layer; the OpsRow IndexNow handler should follow the same pattern rather than reaching for a private helper.
OperatorOpsChecklistCard auto-runs /api/seo/diag on mount (good UX) but the prerender + backup rows are click-to-run. Consider auto-running prerender too for consistency — it's also public and cheap.
ClipsIncentiveCard correctly soft-fails when /api/clips/incentive-status errors (returns null, no toast). Dismiss → localStorage flag → hides across reload all verified.
BroadcastTab.applyTemplate guards body autofill with `!message.trim()` so an admin's draft is never trampled — confirmed via test (existing 'EXISTING DRAFT' preserved on re-apply).
BroadcastTab.applyTemplate also guards subject autofill with `!subject` (no .trim()) — minor inconsistency vs body's `.trim()` guard. A whitespace-only subject would still be overwritten. Cosmetic.

rca of the issue: Root cause for IndexNow ping failure: SettingsTab.jsx line 668 invokes `adminAuthHeaders()` but the function is declared as a `const adminAuthHeaders = () => …` inside /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (NOT in the named exports). JavaScript module scoping means the symbol is undefined inside SettingsTab.jsx, so the click handler throws synchronously before fetch() is called, the catch block reports `e.message = 'adminAuthHeaders is not defined'` via the toast, and ops-indexnow-result never renders. Fix: export the helper from api.js (`export const adminAuthHeaders = …`) and `import { adminAuthHeaders } from '../../lib/api';` in SettingsTab.jsx, OR move the ping call into a new exported wrapper in api.js (recommended — matches the pattern of every other admin call).
